title: विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 220 · Svaha's wish and Rudra as father

summary.en: Svaha tells Skanda that she is his true mother and asks to dwell always with Agni, and he grants that offerings will be made to Agni with her name. Brahma reveals that Rudra, having entered Agni, is Skanda's father, and Markandeya describes the worship of Skanda's hosts.
summary.kn: ತಾನೇ ನಿಜವಾದ ತಾಯಿ ಎಂದು ಸ್ವಾಹಾ ಸ್ಕಂದನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ ಸದಾ ಅಗ್ನಿಯೊಂದಿಗಿರಲು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ಅವಳ ಹೆಸರಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಗ್ನಿಗೆ ಹವಿಸ್ಸು ಅರ್ಪಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವುದೆಂದು ಸ್ಕಂದನು ವರ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದ್ದ ರುದ್ರನೇ ಸ್ಕಂದನ ತಂದೆ ಎಂದು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸ್ಕಂದಗಣಗಳ ಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: स्वाहा स्कन्द से कहती हैं कि वही उनकी सच्ची माता हैं और सदा अग्नि के साथ रहने की माँग करती हैं, और वे वर देते हैं कि अग्नि को उनके नाम के साथ आहुति दी जाएगी। ब्रह्मा बताते हैं कि अग्नि में प्रविष्ट रुद्र ही स्कन्द के पिता हैं, और मार्कण्डेय स्कन्द के गणों की पूजा का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: తానే నిజమైన తల్లినని స్వాహా స్కందునికి చెప్పి ఎల్లప్పుడూ అగ్నితో ఉండాలని కోరుతుంది; ఆమె పేరుతో అగ్నికి హవిస్సు అర్పించబడుతుందని స్కందుడు వరమిస్తాడు. అగ్నిలో ప్రవేశించిన రుద్రుడే స్కందుని తండ్రి అని బ్రహ్మ వెల్లడిస్తాడు; స్కందగణాల పూజను మార్కండేయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தானே உண்மையான அன்னை என்று ஸ்வாஹா ஸ்கந்தனிடம் சொல்லி எப்போதும் அக்னியுடன் வாழ வேண்ட, அவள் பெயருடன் அக்னிக்கு அவி அளிக்கப்படும் என்று அவன் வரம் அளிக்கிறான். அக்னியுள் புகுந்த ருத்ரனே ஸ்கந்தனின் தந்தை என்று ப்ரஹ்மா வெளிப்படுத்த, ஸ்கந்த கணங்களின் வழிபாட்டை மார்க்கண்டேயர் விவரிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: താനാണ് സ്കന്ദന്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ അമ്മയെന്നും, അഗ്നിയോടൊപ്പം എന്നും വസിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹമുണ്ടെന്നും സ്വാഹ പറയുന്നു; അവളുടെ പേരിൽ അഗ്നിക്ക് ആഹുതികൾ നൽകുമെന്ന് സ്കന്ദൻ വരം നൽകുന്നു. അഗ്നിയിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ച രുദ്രനാണ് സ്കന്ദന്റെ പിതാവെന്ന് ബ്രഹ്മാവ് വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു; സ്കന്ദന്റെ സൈന്യങ്ങളുടെ ആരാധനയെ മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.220; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
यदा स्कन्देन मातॄणामेवमेतत्प्रियं कृतम् ।
अथैनमब्रवीत्स्वाहा मम पुत्रस्त्वमौरसः ॥

meaning.en: "When Skanda had done this kindness for the Mothers, Svaha said to him, 'You are my own son.'"

verses.text:
इच्छाम्यहं त्वया दत्तां प्रीतिं परमदुर्लभाम् ।
तामब्रवीत्ततः स्कन्दः प्रीतिमिच्छसि कीदृशीम् ॥

meaning.en: "'I wish for a very rare favor, given by you.' Skanda then asked her, 'What favor do you want?'"

verses.text: स्वाहोवाच

meaning.en: Svaha said:

verses.text:
दक्षस्याहं प्रिया कन्या स्वाहा नाम महाभुज ।
बाल्यात्प्रभृति नित्यं च जातकामा हुताशने ॥

meaning.en: "'I am Daksha's dear daughter, mighty-armed one, named Svaha. Since childhood I have always desired the fire.'"

verses.text:
न च मां कामिनीं पुत्र सम्यग्जानाति पावकः ।
इच्छामि शाश्वतं वासं वस्तुं पुत्र सहाग्निना ॥

meaning.en: "'But Agni does not rightly know that I love him, son. I want to live with Agni forever, my son.'"

verses.text: स्कन्द उवाच

meaning.en: Skanda said:

verses.text:
हव्यं कव्यं च यत्किंचिद्द्विजा मन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् ।
होष्यन्त्यग्नौ सदा देवि स्वाहेत्युक्त्वा समुद्यतम् ॥

meaning.en: "'Whatever offering to gods and ancestors the brahmins will place in the fire, with mantras first and with the word "Svaha" uttered, goddess...'"

verses.text:
अद्य प्रभृति दास्यन्ति सुवृत्ताः सत्पथे स्थिताः ।
एवमग्निस्त्वया सार्धं सदा वत्स्यति शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "'from today the righteous, standing on the true path, will give it so. In this way Agni will always dwell with you, fair one.'"

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता ततः स्वाहा तुष्टा स्कन्देन पूजिता ।
पावकेन समायुक्ता भर्त्रा स्कन्दमपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: "So told, Svaha was delighted and honored by Skanda. Joined with her husband Agni, she honored Skanda."

verses.text:
ततो ब्रह्मा महासेनं प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत् ।
अभिगच्छ महादेवं पितरं त्रिपुरार्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then Brahma, the lord of creatures, said to Mahasena, 'Go to Mahadeva, your father, the destroyer of Tripura.'"

verses.text:
रुद्रेणाग्निं समाविश्य स्वाहामाविश्य चोमया ।
हितार्थं सर्वलोकानां जातस्त्वमपराजितः ॥

meaning.en: "'You were born, unconquered, for the good of all the worlds, when Rudra entered Agni and Uma entered Svaha.'"

verses.text:
उमायोन्यां च रुद्रेण शुक्रं सिक्तं महात्मना ।
आस्ते गिरौ निपतितं मिञ्जिकामिञ्जिकं यतः ॥

meaning.en: "'Rudra, the great soul, shed his seed into Uma's womb, and it fell on the mountain, from which Minjika and Minjikamithuna came.'"

verses.text:
संभूतं लोहितोदे तु शुक्रशेषमवापतत् ।
सूर्यरश्मिषु चाप्यन्यदन्यच्चैवापतद्भुवि ।
आसक्तमन्यद्वृक्षेषु तदेवं पञ्चधापतत् ॥

meaning.en: "'The remainder of the seed fell into the red water; another part fell into the sun's rays, another on the ground, and another clung to the trees; so it fell in five ways.'"

verses.text:
त एते विविधाकारा गणा ज्ञेया मनीषिभिः ।
तव पारिषदा घोरा य एते पिशिताशनाः ॥

meaning.en: "'These troops of various forms are to be known by the wise as your fierce attendants who eat flesh.'"

verses.text:
एवमस्त्विति चाप्युक्त्वा महासेनो महेश्वरम् ।
अपूजयदमेयात्मा पितरं पितृवत्सलः ॥

meaning.en: "Saying 'So be it,' Mahasena, immeasurable in spirit and fond of his father, honored the great lord."

verses.text:
अर्कपुष्पैस्तु ते पञ्च गणाः पूज्या धनार्थिभिः ।
व्याधिप्रशमनार्थं च तेषां पूजां समाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: "Those five troops are to be worshipped with arka flowers by men who want wealth; one should perform worship of them to quell disease."

verses.text:
मिञ्जिकामिञ्जिकं चैव मिथुनं रुद्रसंभवम् ।
नमस्कार्यं सदैवेह बालानां हितमिच्छता ॥

meaning.en: "The pair Minjika and Minjikamithuna, born of Rudra, are always to be revered here by one who wants the good of children."

verses.text:
स्त्रियो मानुषमांसादा वृद्धिका नाम नामतः ।
वृक्षेषु जातास्ता देव्यो नमस्कार्याः प्रजार्थिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Women who eat human flesh, called Vriddhikas, born in the trees, are goddesses to be revered by those who want offspring."

verses.text:
एवमेते पिशाचानामसंख्येया गणाः स्मृताः ।
घण्टायाः सपताकायाः शृणु मे संभवं नृप ॥

meaning.en: "Thus the troops of pishachas are remembered as countless. King, now hear from me the origin of the bell and the banner."

verses.text:
ऐरावतस्य घण्टे द्वे वैजयन्त्याविति श्रुते ।
गुहस्य ते स्वयं दत्ते शक्रेणानाय्य धीमता ॥

meaning.en: "Airavata's two bells, known as Vaijayanti, were brought by the wise Indra and given to Guha himself."

verses.text:
एका तत्र विशाखस्य घण्टा स्कन्दस्य चापरा ।
पताका कार्त्तिकेयस्य विशाखस्य च लोहिता ॥

meaning.en: "One bell there was Vishakha's and the other Skanda's. The red banner belonged to both Karttikeya and Vishakha."

verses.text:
यानि क्रीडनकान्यस्य देवैर्दत्तानि वै तदा ।
तैरेव रमते देवो महासेनो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: "With the toys the gods gave him then, the mighty god Mahasena played."

verses.text:
स संवृतः पिशाचानां गणैर्देवगणैस्तथा ।
शुशुभे काञ्चने शैले दीप्यमानः श्रिया वृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Surrounded by troops of pishachas and hosts of gods, he shone on the golden mountain, blazing, wrapped in glory."

verses.text:
तेन वीरेण शुशुभे स शैलः शुभकाननः ।
आदित्येनेवांशुमता मन्दरश्चारुकन्दरः ॥

meaning.en: "By that hero the mountain with its fair forests shone, as Mandara with its lovely caves shines with the radiant sun."

verses.text:
संतानकवनैः फुल्लैः करवीरवनैरपि ।
पारिजातवनैश्चैव जपाशोकवनैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "With forests of blossoming santanaka, forests of karavira, forests of parijata, and groves of japa and ashoka..."

verses.text:
कदम्बतरुषण्डैश्च दिव्यैर्मृगगणैरपि ।
दिव्यैः पक्षिगणैश्चैव शुशुभे श्वेतपर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "with clumps of kadamba trees, divine herds of beasts and flocks of divine birds, the White Mountain shone."

verses.text:
तत्र देवगणाः सर्वे सर्वे चैव महर्षयः ।
मेघतूर्यरवाश्चैव क्षुब्धोदधिसमस्वनाः ॥

meaning.en: "There were all the hosts of gods and all the great sages, and the sound of instruments like thunder-clouds, resounding like a stirred ocean."

verses.text:
तत्र दिव्याश्च गन्धर्वा नृत्यन्त्यप्सरसस्तथा ।
हृष्टानां तत्र भूतानां श्रूयते निनदो महान् ॥

meaning.en: "There divine gandharvas sang and apsarases danced, and a great roar of delighted beings was heard."

verses.text:
एवं सेन्द्रं जगत्सर्वं श्वेतपर्वतसंस्थितम् ।
प्रहृष्टं प्रेक्षते स्कन्दं न च ग्लायति दर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: "So the whole world, with Indra, stood at the White Mountain and joyfully looked on Skanda, and did not tire of seeing him."
